notes.name: Yancy / Curtis
notes.desc: Em Nimbasa City, depois de devolver o Dropped Item e ligar 15 vezes para o dono, a Yancy (jogando com o Nate) ou o Curtis (com a Rosa) troca um Pokémon diferente por dia, sempre no nível 50 e com a habilidade oculta. Yancy: Meowth, Wobbuffet, Ralts, Shieldon, Rhyhorn, Shellos, Mawile, Spiritomb, Snorlax, Teddiursa, Spinda, Togepi. Curtis: Mankey, Wobbuffet, Ralts, Cranidos, Rhyhorn, Shellos, Sableye, Spiritomb, Snorlax, Phanpy, Spinda, Togepi.

en.desc: In Nimbasa City, after returning the Dropped Item and calling its owner 15 times, Yancy (playing as Nate) or Curtis (as Rosa) trades a different Pokémon each day, always at level 50 and with its Hidden Ability. Yancy: Meowth, Wobbuffet, Ralts, Shieldon, Rhyhorn, Shellos, Mawile, Spiritomb, Snorlax, Teddiursa, Spinda, Togepi. Curtis: Mankey, Wobbuffet, Ralts, Cranidos, Rhyhorn, Shellos, Sableye, Spiritomb, Snorlax, Phanpy, Spinda, Togepi.
